recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-19749 unless Pharmacy separately reopens broader HealthcareService or Organization receiver support under another final issue.
issue_request: FHIR-19749 was a Published FHIR-core Pharmacy change request for MedicationDispense.receiver, raised in STU3 and applied for R5. The original ask was to include Organization and HealthcareService for aged-care delivery scenarios, but the approved Persuasive with Modification resolution was to add Location instead.
initial_application: Jira records application in commit aa42e5dcc1e780bf1fa001dc784d2801f6d3b1d4 on 2019-02-18. That merge changed the then-authoritative medicationdispense-spreadsheet.xml receiver type from Reference(Patient|Practitioner) to Reference(Patient|Practitioner | RelatedPerson | Location) and changed the short/long receiver definitions to mention delivery location use.
additional_context: MedicationDispense is active in source/fhir.ini. The current source has since been refactored to source/medicationdispense/structuredefinition-MedicationDispense.xml, where receiver also includes later Group and Organization target profiles from separate later applied work. FHIR-50109, which added Organization, is already represented on the combined branch; FHIR-41408 added Group as part of broader medication-resource group support. Pharmacy 2018-12-17 meeting minutes corroborate the seed's Location-only resolution, and no conflicting FHIR-19749 Zulip or Confluence key/reference discussion was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope receiver element includes Location as a targetProfile and its definition says receiver may be the location where medication was delivered, satisfying the approved FHIR-19749 resolution. The additional current Organization support is attributable to later FHIR-50109 rather than this seed.

related_jiras.note: Added Organization to MedicationDispense.receiver in R6 and is already represented on the combined branch, explaining why current source is broader than the FHIR-19749 Location-only resolution.
Added Group to MedicationDispense.receiver in later source history, so the current target list is broader than the original R5 application for reasons unrelated to this seed.
